text:
sara: Quick recap — yesterday's paging event (region-us-west) caused request timeouts for ~18 minutes. We mitigated with a config rollback + temporary routing to spare pool. Need RCA draft, timeline, and action items. Who can own initial draft?

oncall-bot: Incident 2467 triggered at 2026-03-16T21:42:05Z. Affected services: inference-gateway, routing-layer. Page sent to @mike, @anna. Severity: SEV2.

mike: I can start the timeline. I'll pull logs and trace spans, aiming for first pass by EOD today.

anna: I'll own customer-impact section and coordinate with support for affected tenants. ETA tomorrow morning. :+1:

liam: Platform to review kernel selection decision that rolled out two hours before the spike — seems correlated. Tagging @elaine for infra context.

elaine: I'll fetch deployment history and the canary metrics. Quick note: there was a rolling kernel switch at 19:02 that increased median p50 by ~8ms but p95 jumped at 21:40. Suspect an interaction with batching.

mike: Timeline plan (first pass):
```
- 19:02: kernel-switch rollout started (canary)
- 19:10: canary healthy
- 20:30: gradual rollout to 60%
- 21:38: start of error rate rise on inference-gateway
- 21:42: alert triggered, page sent
- 21:47: routing failover to spare pool
- 22:00: rollback to previous kernel completed
- 22:15: error rates normalized
```

sara: Good. For the RCA draft we need: timeline, contributing factors (tech + process), scope & impact (customers + internal), mitigations and long-term fixes, owners, and a deadline for sign-off.

liam: Contributing factors I see so far: untested kernel interaction with KV-cache eviction under certain batch sizes; rollout policy allowed fast ramp; missing synthetic that exercised long tails.

anna: Customer impact notes: 7 customers saw elevated latencies, 2 experienced timeouts that retried and failed. Support has a list and will prepare outreach drafts.

elaine: Short-term mitigation action items: 1) pin kernel for pending rollouts until QA verifies k-v eviction behavior (owner: liam), 2) add tighter rollout ramp / automatic rollback on p95 delta > 20% (owner: dev-platform-bot -> infra owners), 3) add a synthetic that simulates heavy KV cache churn (owner: mike).

mike: I'll open the RCA PR in the repo: https://git.internal/redwood/rca/2467 (WIP). Please comment on the timeline and add any logs.

anna: Can we schedule a 30m postmortem sync tomorrow 10:30am PT? Need platform + infra + support. @liam @elaine @mike confirm.

liam: 10:30 PT works for me.

elaine: I'll be there.

mike: ok for me.

sara: Great — meeting scheduled. For peer review: aim to have internal peer review complete within 48 hours of meeting. Final sign-off by engineering manager + security (if customer data touched).

liam: Question about mitigations: do we want a hotfix to change default batch size safe cap immediately? That could reduce throughput but might prevent tail events.

elaine: Agree we should consider a temporary cap. Put it as a mitigation option and cost assessment in the doc.

mike: Added a TODO in the PR for capacity/cost estimates. @sara can you route to PM for customer comms approval after support drafts the outreach?

sara: Yup I'll handle PM routing after support posts the draft.

dev-platform-bot: Action created: "2467-1 pin-kernel-on-rollback" assigned to @liam, due 2026-03-20.

dev-platform-bot: Action created: "2467-2 add-p95-rollback-policy" assigned to infra-team, due 2026-03-23.

mike: I've pushed initial timeline + logs to the PR. Please add any troubleshooting notes or test results.

anna: Support will post customer list and sample error traces by 09:00 PT tomorrow.

elaine: Will attach deployment snapshots and perf graphs to the PR before the sync.

sara: Postmortem sign-off checklist (in thread so it's visible):
- [ ] Draft created (owner: mike)
- [ ] Customer-impact section (owner: anna)
- [ ] Contributing factors + evidence (owner: liam/elaine)
- [ ] Mitigations + owners (owner: team)
- [ ] Cost/throughput assessment for any cap/hotfix (owner: mike)
- [ ] Peer review completed (2 reviewers)
- [ ] EM sign-off and close (owner: sara)

mike: I'll ping for reviewers once the PR has logs. Looking for 1 infra and 1 runtime reviewer.

anna: quick note — support recommends proactive emails for the two impacted customers and a status post for the broader tenant list.

liam: After sign-off, please add the follow-ups to the operational runbook for kernel rollouts.

elaine: A reminder: include test cases for KV cache eviction in CI. Without that we'll likely regress.

sara: Thanks everyone. Meeting invite sent. We'll reconvene in the thread after the sync with finalized owners and timeline. :calendar:

mike: End-to-end: PR link + meeting notes will be in the doc. I'll update last_message_ts when PR is ready.

oncall-bot: Incident 2467 marked as "postmortem_required". Postmortem assigned to channel postmortems.

sara: Closing loop for now. Please update the PR and the thread with any new findings before the scheduled sync.
